name: Michelle
source:
Time Suit: ???
Interests: Ballet
Likes: Iced tea

The stern and serious commander of the Time Tenshi. She oversees each operation remotely from the Time Window facility. She's strict when it comes to the subject of time travel, but she also has a naughtier side. And it's best not to get on her bad side!

[spoiler]She was last seen in a terrible accident involving the Time Window. Her current status and condition are unknown.[/spoiler]
